entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are we going the right way? I[n]feel like we're going to get lost.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hmmm... We passed through a[n]blue gate, so I suppose we're[n]in Chinatown now, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There was something I wanted to[n]try here... Hm, what was it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Pork buns? Sesame dumplings?[n]No, that's not it... Sorry, it's[n]completely slipped my mind...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It has shrimp and cabbage inside,[n]and it's wrapped in rice paper...
Peking duck?
Egg rolls?
Spring rolls?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Not exactly. The wrapper you[n]use for Peking duck is made[n]from flour, not rice.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh... I remember now! Spring rolls!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, that was close! I was[n]thinking of spring rolls!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The roll part helped me[n]remember! Thanks for the hint.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's it! I don't know[n]why I forgot the name.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I know I can get them in Tokyo,[n]but I might as well have an[n]authentic Chinese one here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What's wrong? You're frowning.
It's not Chinese.
Let's find some.[clr 27]
I don't like cilantro...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Oh, they're Vietnamese! Why[n]did I think they were Chinese...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Actually... wait a second.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: China and Vietnam are right next[n]to each other. Maybe we'll still[n]be able to find some here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, wait... Aren't spring[n]rolls Vietnamese...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Sis would get mad at me if I[n]made a mistake like this on[n]an exam... Then again...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: China and Vietnam are right next[n]to each other. Maybe we'll still[n]be able to find some here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Cilantro...? Hold on a second...[n]Spring rolls are Vietnamese...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: *sigh* Why did I get them[n]mixed up...? No, wait...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: China and Vietnam are right next[n]to each other. Maybe we'll still[n]be able to find some here...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why don't we start looking?[n]This is going to be fun.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If we're going to get lost, we[n]might as well get lost completely.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Come on, let's start with[n]that street over there!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Here, this is a present for you.[n]It was so cute, I couldn't help but buy it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We should go home... but[n]which way is the station?
